name: Grammarly
description: Grammarly checks spelling, grammar and tone as you type in the browser and many apps, and offers AI prompts for rewriting and drafting.
features: Writing mistake checks and tone view
AI prompts per month (100 on Free, 2,000 per member on Pro)
Full-sentence rewrites, tone adjustment and citation consistency (Pro)
Team analytics, style guides and brand tones (Pro and Enterprise)
limitations: Suggestions are not always right for your style
It does not check whether your facts are correct

plans.name: Pro
highlights: 2,000 AI prompts per member per month
Snippets, Knowledge Share, priority support, Team Analytics
plans.note: $12 USD is shown without a billing-period label on the page we read; the page describes Pro as 'for eligible individuals and teams'

plans.name: Enterprise
highlights: SAML single sign-on, SCIM, audit logs API

free.details: Writing mistake checks, writing tone view and 100 AI prompts per month.

pricing.trial: Pro shows 'Try for free' with $0 payment today and an email reminder 2 days before the trial ends; the trial length is not stated.
pricing.regional: Prices are shown only in USD.

verification.notes: Product active (the page now mentions availability through Superhuman Go). Free $0 with 100 AI prompts; Pro shows $12 USD with no billing-period label, a $0-today free trial (reminder 2 days before it ends) and 2,000 AI prompts; Enterprise by sales. Because the Pro billing period is unlabelled, it stays partial.

profile.headline: Writing help that checks grammar, tone and how your reader will take it

capabilities.title: Fix and polish your writing
capabilities.text: Proofreading refines grammar, structure and clarity, and paragraph rewrites improve flow with one click.

capabilities.title: Match the tone to the audience
capabilities.text: Tone suggestions adapt a message to its context.

capabilities.title: See your text through a reader's eyes
capabilities.text: Reader Reactions reviews your writing from your audience's point of view.

capabilities.title: Check for AI-written text
capabilities.text: An AI Detector agent identifies AI-generated text and the areas you may want to revise.

featureCards.name: Humanizer agent
featureCards.text: Adds personality to writing that reads flat.

featureCards.name: Plagiarism Checker and Citation tools
featureCards.text: The site lists a Plagiarism Checker, a Citation Generator and a Citation Finder.

featureCards.name: Paraphrasing and Translator
featureCards.text: Rewrite a passage in other words, or translate it.

featureCards.name: AI Chat and AI Grader
featureCards.text: Ask for help in a chat, or have a draft graded.

featureCards.name: Team style tools
featureCards.text: Style Guide, Snippets, Analytics and Brand Tones help a team write consistently.

featureCards.name: Works where you write
featureCards.text: Install it on the desktop, as a browser extension, on mobile, or in Microsoft Office and Google Docs.

audienceDetail.text: Anyone who wants clearer writing in email, documents and messages.
Citation and grading tools are aimed at education.
The site names customer support, marketing, IT, sales and HR teams.
The Enterprise plan adds dedicated support and controls such as roles and permissions.

scenarios.title: Make a message clearer
scenarios.text: Shorten and sharpen an email before you send it.

scenarios.title: Write in the brand's voice
scenarios.text: The site shows a support team following a brand style guide.

scenarios.title: Check an AI-assisted draft
scenarios.text: Find the parts that read as AI-generated and revise them.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Sign up button with an email address or a Google account.
Add the desktop app, the browser extension, the mobile keyboard, or the add-in for Microsoft Office or Google Docs.
Request a demo or contact sales for the Enterprise plan.
